brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Three stacked half-s bases: piece:0,0,0;half-s (level 0), piece:0,0,1;half-s (level 1), piece:0,0,2;half-s (level 2) with stacking collars and snaps; total height 240 mm (3×80 mm). Verified by get_build and measure.

Vertical column with top cover cover:0,0,2;half-s;top closing the top face and edge caps cap:0,0,0;*;270 and cap:0,0,1;*;270 closing open sides; joints locked via lockJoints; meshClash clear and check_build OK.

Exactly three drawers installed on the north cut faces: drawer:0#0,0#cut (level 0), drawer:1#0,0#cut (level 1), drawer:2#0,0#cut (level 2) – one per storey, each with drawer body, frame, lid and runner.

finish.summary: Built a three-level vertical cabinet from three half-s hex bases stacked at 0,0,0 to 0,0,2, each level fitted with a north-facing drawer (3 total). Top closed with a half-s cover and open edges capped, joints locked, mesh verified clear.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your three-storey cabinet is on deck — I'll line up a tall frame with space for three drawers.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base (variant half-n, half-s, half-e or half-w) first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
